title: Fix Mcp Tooling For All Agents
description: Fix MCP tooling so all agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Kiro CLI, GitHub Copilot) can access all MCP servers. Issues: .mcp.json only has repo; coda path wrong in kiro/codex configs pointing to coda/engine/coda.py instead of coda/assistant/main.py; .github/agents/compose.agent.md has no MCP servers.
summary: Fixed MCP tooling for all agents. Added playwright-test, compose, coda servers to .mcp.json. Fixed coda path from coda/engine/coda.py to coda/assistant/main.py in .kiro/settings/mcp.json, .kiro/agents/compose.json, .codex/config.toml. Added all 4 MCP servers to .vscode/mcp.json. Added mcp/* tool entries to .github/agents/compose.agent.md.
